item.title: Insider Buying This Week: A Three-Day Streak, a Director's Small Add, and a Fund Building a Stake
item.description:
Three Form 4 filings from this week illustrate three different shapes open-market insider buying can take — a multi-day executive buying streak, a small routine director purchase, and a large institutional stake build. All figures below are taken directly from the filings.

Navios Maritime Partners (NMM): three consecutive buying days
